assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: reusable vertically extensible Cecilia QQ help-page background, 1024x1536.
Input roles: image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the user's CHOSEN design, image 2 is supporting original clean stationery reference.
Primary request: turn the chosen completed help card into a production background for dynamic text rendering. KEEP the entire upper header from y=0 through y=510 pixel-identical as much as possible: Cecilia's delicate face and portrait, pale ash-blonde sage hair, floral frame, small '/help' and large artistic rose-brown '指令手册', their lettering style and layout, fine gold details, the botanical top corners. The user specifically chose this title and style.
REMOVE EVERY menu category, '/help ...' command, associated gold row ornaments, and both footer instructions. Restore clean ivory paper where removed.
Crucial reusable layout: the MIDDLE BAND from y=512 to y=1280 must be a uniform near-white warm ivory paper color, perfectly empty, with only very thin straight vertical gold outer border lines near x=28 and x=996. NO flowers, NO leaves, NO petals, NO swashes, NO shadows, NO gradients, NO texture or repeated motifs anywhere in this middle band, including its outer margins. This band will be extended vertically by software; absolute uniformity makes extension seamless. Blend the header into this same flat ivory by y=512. Leave the header's fixed decorations intact above that line.
The BOTTOM BAND from y=1280 to y=1536 keeps the beautiful original flowers, sage foliage, bottom corner and gold bottom border ornament, with EMPTY light ivory area in its upper middle to receive two small software-added footer lines. The bottom band will remain its fixed original height and move down when content grows. All bottom flowers must be wholly contained within this bottom band, no branches protruding into the middle band. Keep its middle fill the same uniform ivory color as the middle band.
Text invariants: ONLY '/help' and '指令手册' remain in the fixed upper header. No other letters, category labels, numbers, help commands, footer words or watermark anywhere. Do NOT add boxes, grid tiles or dividers in the body. Preserve the chosen restrained illustrated stationery style and the girl identity, airy, refined, warm and gently shy. Flat front-facing image, not a mockup.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: reusable Cecilia personal-status card background, portrait 1024x1536, also suitable for later dynamic shop layouts.
The input image is the user's chosen EDIT TARGET. Preserve its tender anime character identity, face, hair, portrait frame, upper botanical decoration, quiet ivory stationery palette, thin gold outer border and restrained warm rose-brown artistic headline style.
Replace only the large headline '指令手册' with exactly '塞西莉亚', in the SAME original gentle individually drawn Chinese lettering style, color, weight and placement. Keep the four characters readable and separate, not connected cursive. Remove the small '/help' above it and leave this area empty for a software-added small subtitle.
Remove ALL eight menu rows, command strings, per-row ornaments and both footer lines. This will be a background: dynamic user names and accurate stats will be drawn by software.
For vertical extensibility, from y=512 to y=1280 the entire MIDDLE BAND must be perfectly flat uniform very pale warm ivory, absolutely empty, except thin straight gold vertical outer border lines at x around 28 and 996. No flowers, foliage, petals, repeated motifs, text, shadows, gradients or texture inside that band, including its edge margins. The middle must be capable of seamless vertical resizing without stretching artwork.
Keep header decorations and the entire portrait wholly ABOVE y=512, without redesigning the face or enlarging the character. Keep lovely bottom floral corner decorations, sage leaves and the thin bottom border wholly within y=1280..1536. Bottom center must be empty and light for a discreet software-added footer. All bottom foliage must remain inside this fixed-height bottom band; do not protrude into the extendable middle.
Only text visible on the final asset: the large header '塞西莉亚'. No other letters, no numbers, no labels, no mock stats, no watermark. No card boxes, tiles or filled panels in the content area. Keep the chosen gentle art-lettering, refined airy composition and warm shyness. Flat front-facing image.
